text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: [prod-inference-timeouts] triggered at 2026-03-14 03:20 UTC. Primary on-call @lex notified. Incident link: https://pd.example/incidents/INC12345 :rotating_light: Please acknowledge.

pagerduty-bot: No acknowledgement from primary after 3m. Escalating to secondary on-call @maria and notifying manager per policy.

maria: ack — I'm on call, looking into it now. Pulling up grafana and logs.

maria: grafana: https://grafana.example/d/abc123/prod-inference?orgId=1 -> p99 latency spiked to ~12s, error rate ~6% (500s).

maria: quick logs check:
```
$ k logs -n inference svc/inference-primary --since=15m | grep "error 500" | head -n 20
[2026-03-14T03:15:21Z] ERROR handler.go:123 request_id=... 500 internal server error: kv cache miss and OOM
```

jamie: I can see a canary rollout for model v1.5-beta pushed at ~03:15 to 10% traffic. traffic spiked around then. Could be regression in the new runtime path.

maria: agreed, i'm going to pin traffic back to v1.4.2 and scale canary to 0%. Running patch now.

maria: rollout command:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/inference-deploy model-server=image:v1.4.2 && kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-deploy -w
```

pagerduty-bot: Manager escalation: @sre-oncall-manager has been notified (escalation level: manager) because primary missed initial ack window.

sre-oncall-manager: ack — I'm on it. Maria proceed with rollback and coordinate customer comms. Jamie, grab CS if needed.

maria: rollback complete, pin confirmed to v1.4.2, canary scaled to 0%. Observability shows errors trending down.

lex: sorry team — I was on mobile and DND suppressed the page. Just saw the notification now. Will follow up to adjust PD mobile settings. :man_facepalming:

jamie: customer impact summary so far: ~2% of requests experienced 500s between 03:15-03:26 UTC. Affected customers: a handful of high-throughput tenants (HH corp ids: 781, 784). CS alerted and prepared incident banner.

maria: current metrics: p99 12.4s -> 0.18s, error rate 6% -> 0.2% after rollback. Looks stable for last 6m.

maria: closing the PD incident now. Will open a postmortem ticket with timeline, root cause hypothesis (model runtime change -> kv-cache behavior + OOM), and action items:
- require canary perf test for new runtime flags
- PD mobile settings: ensure primary oncall mobile overrides DND for P1
- add automated cache-miss alarm to detect runaway cache miss rates

incident-bot: Incident INC12345 resolved by maria. Duration ~00:11. Postmortem ticket: ENG-PLAT-4123 assigned to eng-runtime.

pagerduty-bot: Note: there was a secondary/manager escalation because primary did not acknowledge within the initial window. Recommend reviewing escalation timing and mobile notify settings to avoid noisy manager pages.

lex: noted. i'll update my PD notification profile and follow up on the postmortem actions. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
